claim_boundary: The implementation adapts BATON's published transition-aware design to the repository's auditable symbolic task model and GR00T language adapter. Paper baselines are mechanism-matched proxies, not official code or checkpoints. Isaac Sim SONIC results validate the unchanged whole-body execution substrate, not end-to-end object recovery.
